source_layouts._forward_layout_comment: LOCKED 29 Jul 2026 to 'TMP Batch Ninja Depok (Order) 28-07-26.xlsx'; re-applied here 18 Aug 2026 after the repo reorg dropped the earlier fix. SwipeRx removed the leading index column and the per-PO Weight/Volume columns, shifting every field left: ONE header row (data starts row 2), nothing past col M. Both forward services share this layout. Continuation PO rows carry only E..M (A/B/C blank). Older batches (4 header rows, koli in N or W) will NOT parse against this.

rdo_text._forward_comment: Guide §2.4 (New RDO deck). `forward` is MANDATED compliance wording and is never trimmed. `forward_cta` is discretionary and is dropped whole when the 500-char col-R budget is tight — which happened 27 Jul when the host gained a '.ninjavan.' segment, growing the URL 9 chars (counted twice) and cutting CTA room from 29 to 11.
